info.title: AI Relay API
info.description: 统一的 AI Model 调用接口，支持 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini、Kling、即梦等多种格式

get.description: Retrieves the currently available model list. The response format is detected automatically from request headers: - Returns Anthropic format when `x-api-key` and `anthropic-version` headers are present - Returns Gemini format when the `x-goog-api-key` header or `key` query parameter is present - Returns OpenAI format otherwise
Returns available models in Gemini API format

post.description: Creates a model response from conversation history. Supports streaming and non-streaming responses. Compatible with the OpenAI Chat Completions API.
OpenAI Responses API，Used to create model responses. Supports multi-turn conversations, tool calls, and reasoning.
OpenAI Responses API，Used to compact long conversations.
提交异步图片生成 Tasks 。支持 OpenAI 兼容格式（DALL-E）以及各厂商原生格式。 Returns a task ID that can be used to query task status with the GET endpoint.
Qwen image generation through Bailian
OpenAI Sora 兼容的 Video 生成接口。 支持文生 Video 和图生 Video （通过 input_reference 参数传入参考图片）。 参考文档: https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/videos/create

get.description: OpenAI-compatible video task status endpoint. Returns detailed video task status information.
Gets the video file content for a completed video task. This endpoint proxies and returns the video file stream.

404.description: Video not found or not completed

post.description: Generates a video from a text prompt using a Kling model. Supported models:kling-v1, kling-v1-5 等

get.description: Queries the status and result of a Kling text-to-video task.

post.description: Generates a video from an image using a Kling model. Supports passing an image URL or Base64-encoded image data through the `image` parameter.

get.description: Queries the status and result of a Kling image-to-video task.

post.description: Video generation endpoint using the official Jimeng API format. Use the Action parameter to specify the operation type: - `CVSync2AsyncSubmitTask`: submit a video generation task - `CVSync2AsyncGetResult`: get task result Action and Version must be specified as query parameters.

submit a video generation task（ General 格式）。 支持多种 Model （Kling、Hailuo、Sora 等），通过 model 参数选择。 支持文生 Video （prompt 参数）和图生 Video （image 参数）。 Returns a task ID that can be used to query task status with the GET endpoint.

get.description: Queries the status and result of a video generation task. Task status: - `queued`: queued - `in_progress`: in progress - `completed`: completed - `failed`: Failed
